plugins.name: dioxus
plugins.description: Dioxus 0.7 expert: local docs, example and source search, Serena MCP for Rust symbols, and a dioxus-expert subagent that cites its sources.

plugins.name: p4
plugins.description: P4 / Tofino SDE SME: bundled source-grounded P4 corpus (P4_16 spec, TNA, BF-Runtime, SDE guides, tutorials) served via a knowledge-rag MCP, and a p4-expert subagent that cites every answer for Q&A, codegen, and review across the full P4 stack (p4c/bf-p4c, P4Runtime/BF-RT, open-p4studio, bmv2/Tofino).

plugins.name: language-tutor
plugins.description: Learn a new language with a Claude-powered tutor. The tutor can help you practice reading, writing, and speaking in your target language, and provide feedback on your progress.

plugins.name: swiss-transport
plugins.description: Accurate Swiss public-transport lookups — train/bus/tram/boat connections, live departure & arrival boards, and station search — via the keyless public search.ch timetable API.

plugins.name: gdt
plugins.description: Gaëtan's dev tooling — personal development-workflow skills. sdd: autonomous spec-driven development (worktree → specs → plan → adversarial review → execution). memory-optimization: fan-out audit that fact-checks a Claude Code memory store against the live system, consolidates it, and rebuilds MEMORY.md. worktree-sweep: fans a diagnostics backlog (clippy lints, compiler warnings) out to one worktree agent per rule family, lands the fixes linearly, verifies, and cleans up.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Data-driven guardrails for agent Bash commands: deny or warn rules with per-command retry, session modes an agent may enable only when you say so, global and per-project state, and presets (docs-first, process-safety, modern-cli, shell-hygiene) installed by a setup skill.

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: chezmoi dotfile-manager expertise — source-state attribute grammar, templating, scripts, externals, encryption and secrets — plus update/push skills that resolve sync conflicts autonomously and a hook that flags source/destination drift.

plugins.name: tgrep
plugins.description: Search with tgrep (Microsoft's trigram-indexed, ripgrep-compatible grep) instead of the Grep tool — a SessionStart hook keeps a tgrep server warm per repository without double-serving, a search skill that loads live index state and gets command shape, scoping and freshness right, and a hook skill to disable, exclude a repo, or stop a server.
